name: OpenFlux Exit Node
description: Runs an OpenFlux exit node on the router. Phones running OpenFluxAndroid tunnel their traffic through whitelisted transports (Yandex Docs/Volga, MAX, Cups.online, Mail.ru) and out through the router's WAN. Own web panel: http://router/openflux/ (like the olcRTC tunnel module).
author: titovcode
